core_obligations: The author identifies the q-enriched generating function of a skew Young poset with the Hall-Littlewood S-function at t=-q, using the signed-alphabet generating series and its morphism to the Hall-Littlewood coefficients. Weight-preserving standardization of marked tableaux then yields the expansion over standard tableaux in q-fundamental quasisymmetric functions. Identification and expansion are one skew-function object; Schur/Schur-Q endpoints and induced ring-map consequences are not extra counts.
